title: NaCl Evaporation System resolved engineering brief from Stage 1 notes
narrative:
Canonical elements consolidated from the notes are: charging tank B1 (initial water-rich charge and recovered-water destination), charging tank B2 (initial concentrated-NaCl charge and recovered-concentrate destination), mixing tank B3, intermediate/output tank B4, evaporator vessel B5 with heater actuator B5_Heater, condenser K1, condensate cooling/return tank B6 with cooler actuator B6_Cooler, concentrate cooling/return tank B7 with cooler actuator B7_Cooler, return pumps P1 and P2, automated discrete valves V1, V3, V5, V6, V8, V9, V11, V12, V15, V18, V20, V22, V23, V24, V25, and instruments/sensors LIS-301, QI-302, LIS-501, QIS-502, TI-503, TIS-602, TIS-702, FIS-801, PIS-901, and PIS-1001. Notes 02_02_process_data_register_chunk01 identify aliases and fuller names: B1/B2 charging tanks, B3 mixing tank, B7 as a buffer/return tank in one note, evaporator vessel D8 corresponding to B5 by sensor pairing LIS-501/QIS-502/TI-503, condenser B9 corresponding to K1 by cooling-water function, cooling tanks B10/B11 corresponding to B6/B7 by LIS-601/TIS-602 and LIS-701/TIS-702. 04_11_legacy_architecture and 01_01_process_requirement_specification agree on the main process topology B1 -> B3 through V8, B2 -> B3 through V9, B3 -> B4 through V11, B4 -> B5 through V12, B5 -> K1 as vapor/process side, K1 -> B6 as condensate, and B5 -> B7 through V15. 04_11_legacy_architecture further states B7 -> P1 and B6 -> P2. Return routing is materially revised by 09_05_process_controls_email_thread and 02_02_process_data_register_chunk04: approved/current routing is B6 condensate returns to B1 and B7 concentrate returns to B2, with CR-017 approved on 2026-03-05 correcting return-stream destinations and B7 cooling target to 25 degC. The return-path valve groups are stated in 09_05_process_controls_email_thread: B7/P1 branch routes through V18/V23/V22 plus V1/V3 to B1, and B6/P2 branch routes through V20/V24/V25 plus V5/V6 to B2. Some other notes reverse these destinations; those older/conflicting candidates are preserved in questions and not treated as resolved facts. 

Controller-facing sensor inputs explicitly required by 02_02_process_data_register_chunk01 REQ-DAT-001 are LIS-301, QI-302, LIS-501, QIS-502, TIS-602, TIS-702, and FIS-801. Controller actuator outputs explicitly required by REQ-DAT-002 are the 15 automated valve commands, pump commands P1 and P2, B5 heater, B6 cooler, and B7 cooler. 02_02_process_data_register_chunk03 adds a Central controller receiving measured values from Sensors and commanding Actuators. 06_06_design_review_minutes states the controller is a sequential StateGraph with a parallel split after evaporation and a join before cycle reset. Automated process valves are discrete and fail closed per 06_06_design_review_minutes, consistent with 11_08_valve_pump_datasheet for 2/2-way solenoid/pneumatic discrete valves: Boolean open command, 24 VDC actuation, spring-return closed, nominal opening time 0.7 s, nominal closing time 0.5 s, leakage at closed <0.02% Kv, permitted medium water / aqueous NaCl at 0-120 degC. 

The most complete explicit control sequence is in 02_02_process_data_register_chunk03 StateGraph, supported by 01_01_process_requirement_specification and 05_04_control_sequence_design. Consolidated state sequence: Initial/Idle-Reset: all valves closed, pumps/heaters/coolers off; transition requires startEnable and B3 available according to 02_02_process_data_register_chunk03. Step1 Water charge to B3: command V8 open; completion when LIS-301 >= 0.13 m. Step2 Brine charge/mix in B3: command V9 open; completion when QI-302 >= 0.080 kg/kg. Step3 Transfer B3 to B4: command V11 open; completion when LIS-301 < 0.01 m (12_09_batch_acceptance_test phrases this as B3 below 0.01 m and one line says <=0.01 m; the more repeated guard is <0.01 m). Step4 Wait for B5 idle: no transfer actuator; completion when LIS-501 < 0.01 m and NOT V15. Step5 Transfer B4 to B5: command V12 open; completion when LIS-501 >= 0.18 m. Step6 Heat/evaporate B5: command B5_Heater on; completion when QIS-502 >= 0.180 kg/kg. After evaporation the controller splits into parallel branches per 02_02_process_data_register_chunk03 and 12_09_batch_acceptance_test. Branch A in the notes is the condensate branch, but the detailed branch states are incomplete in the provided Stage 1 notes; 01_01_process_requirement_specification states 'When QIS-502 reaches evaporation target then Cool B6, then return condensate.' Branch B is the concentrate branch and is explicitly expanded in 02_02_process_data_register_chunk03: Step7 wait for B7 idle, no transfer actuator, completion LIS-701 < 0.01 m; Step8 transfer B5 concentrate to B7, V15 open, completion LIS-501 < 0.01 m; Step9 cool concentrate in B7, B7_Cooler on, completion TIS-702 <= 25 degC. 05_04_control_sequence_design adds return actions: after B6 return complete, P2 on plus corrected B1/B2 return valve group wording is conflicting with 09_05 email routing; after B7 return complete, P1 on plus corrected valve group. Because Stage 1 notes do not contain a full approved Branch A state list analogous to Step7-Step9, only the evidence-grounded condensate branch facts are retained: B5 vapor/process stream goes to K1, K1 provides condensate to B6, B6 is cooled, B6 must satisfy TIS-602 <= 20 degC before P2 return, and the cycle includes a parallel split and rejoin. Join/JoinWait: wait for both branches complete; cycle reset only when both branches complete and time > 2500 s; then return to Initial. This minimum restart time of 2500 s is stated in 02_02_process_data_register_chunk03 and controller restartTime=2500 is also in 10_07_legacy_evaporation_plant. 01_01_process_requirement_specification requires the simulation to continue beyond 2500 s to demonstrate cycle reset, and 02_02_process_data_register_chunk01 REQ-VV-001 requires at least one parallel-branch split and rejoin and continuation beyond 2500 s. 

Permissives and interlocks explicitly grounded in the notes: 06_06_design_review_minutes states B5 heater permissive requires LIS-501 >= 0.05 m and FIS-801 >= 0.10 kg/s. 06_06_design_review_minutes also states P1 and P2 have dry-run inhibit from source-tank level. 11_08_valve_pump_datasheet states dry-run policy of P1 and P2 is inhibit start / trip. 11_08_valve_pump_datasheet gives a minimum source level permissive of LIS-701 > 0.02 m and low discharge pressure alarm of PIS-901 < 0.8 bar; the notes do not provide an equivalent explicit LIS-601 minimum level for P2, so silence is preserved. 02_02_process_data_register_chunk02 gives operating bounds/constraints: heater TI-503 between 0 and 130 degC with constraint TI-503 <= 130 degC; cooling-complete temperatures TIS-602 and TIS-702 between 0 and 120 degC with process constraints TIS-602 <= 20 degC and TIS-702 <= 25 degC; minimum cooling water flow FIS-801 between 0.10 and 0.50 kg/s with constraint FIS-801 >= 0.10 kg/s; PIS-901 and PIS-1001 between 0 and 4.00 bar(g) with constraints <= 4.00 bar(g). Tank level ranges/bounds from 02_02_process_data_register_chunk02 and 10_07_legacy_evaporation_plant include B1 and B2 max level 0.60 m, B3 and B4 max level 0.45 m, B6 and B7 max level 0.40 m, and B5 levelMax 0.45 m in the legacy model; B5 geometry there is area=0.060 and B6/B7 area=0.050, while 02_02_process_data_register_chunk01 gives capacities and dimensions for tanks. These geometric data are descriptive but not fully cross-linked to equations in the provided notes. 

Setpoints and resolved values with provenance: B3 water-prefill threshold/current exit criterion LIS-301 >= 0.13 m from 01_01_process_requirement_specification, 02_02_process_data_register_chunk03 StateGraph, 05_04_control_sequence_design, and 12_09_batch_acceptance_test. B3 target concentration/current exit criterion QI-302 >= 0.080 kg/kg from 02_02_process_data_register_chunk03, 05_04_control_sequence_design, 10_07_legacy_evaporation_plant controller.B3_target_X=0.080, and 12_09_batch_acceptance_test. B3 empty criterion LIS-301 < 0.01 m from 01_01_process_requirement_specification and 02_02_process_data_register_chunk03; acceptance note 12_09 uses below 0.01 m and one behavior line says <=0.01 m. B5 idle/wait criterion LIS-501 < 0.01 m and NOT V15 from 02_02_process_data_register_chunk03. B5 charge completion criterion LIS-501 >= 0.18 m from 02_02_process_data_register_chunk03, 05_04_control_sequence_design, and 10_07_legacy_evaporation_plant controller.B5_batch_level=0.18. B5 evaporation target/current exit criterion QIS-502 >= 0.180 kg/kg from 02_02_process_data_register_chunk03, 05_04_control_sequence_design, 10_07_legacy_evaporation_plant controller.B5_target_X=0.180, and 12_09_batch_acceptance_test. B6 cooling completion criterion TIS-602 <= 20 degC from 05_04_control_sequence_design, 09_05_process_controls_email_thread, and 12_09_batch_acceptance_test. B7 cooling completion criterion TIS-702 <= 25 degC from 05_04_control_sequence_design, 09_05_process_controls_email_thread, 02_02_process_data_register_chunk04 approved correction CR-017, and 12_09_batch_acceptance_test. A conflicting older B7 temperature of 20 C is noted in 08_15_lab_notebook but is superseded by CR-017 approved correction to 25 degC. Synthetic cooling duties for benchmark are B6 = -6500 W and B7 = -4500 W from 02_02_process_data_register_chunk03 and 02_02_process_data_register_chunk04 A10 Thermal Sizing Memo released on 2026-03-19. Restart time/current cycle reset minimum is 2500 s from 02_02_process_data_register_chunk03, 10_07_legacy_evaporation_plant, and 01_01_process_requirement_specification. Acceptance duration/current test horizon is 3000 s from 02_02_process_data_register_chunk04 A11/A12 and the 14_10 batch run notes, while separate notes request reporting for a 900-second experiment (02_02_process_data_register_chunk02, 02_02_process_data_register_chunk03, 05_04_control_sequence_design, 13_14_operator_runbook). Those are different contexts and are not automatically merged. 

Physical modeling evidence grounded in 07_13_water_nacl_medium_notes: the intended physical medium remains WaterNaCl, and 06_06_design_review_minutes states StandardWater is a topology/control integration baseline only. WaterNaCl is a specialization of PartialMixtureTwoPhaseMedium. Reported physical relationships are der(m) = sum(topPorts.m_flow) + sum(ports.m_flow) and der(U) = sum(H_flow) - p_ambient*der(V). A condensation-related relation is given as m_con = -(heatPort.Q_flow - Q_up) / (hv - hl + Xi[1]*(cp*dT_dX + dhl_dX)). The notes also state: if controller.actuators.T5_Heater is true, then HeatB5.Q_flow = 20000 else HeatB5.Q_flow = 0; 10_07_legacy_evaporation_plant repeats B5.heatPort.Q_flow = if controller.actuators.T5_Heater then 20000 else 0. Units for this heater command are not explicitly stated in those two notes, but the quantity is Q_flow and 02_02_process_data_register_chunk03 refers to nominal cooling duty in W, so the narrative preserves the exact equation without adding unstated unit certainty. 07_13_water_nacl_medium_notes also gives modeling constraints for ports above liquid level: large outflow loss factor default 1e5 and small inflow factor default 0.01. 01_01_process_requirement_specification adds constraints that tank connections can pass above or below the liquid level, small junction volumes shall be used, and all non-horizontal pipes shall include static head in their pressure-drop relationship. 15_12_layout_coordinates says the coordinates are approximate CAD/BIM export and relative elevation should be used for gravity pressure-drop constraints; reported base elevations are B1 4.8 m, B2 4.8 m, B3 3.5 m, B4 2.6 m, B5 1.5 m, K1 2.8 m, B6 1.5 m, B7 0.7 m, P1 0.0 m, P2 0.0 m. Derived consequence: because the notes explicitly require static head in non-horizontal pipes and provide approximate relative elevations, later modeling can include gravity head terms using relative elevation differences, but no pipe-by-pipe equation is provided here. 

Observed or logged run evidence from the 14_10_batch_run_3000s chunks is incomplete and internally inconsistent, so it is treated as supporting evidence rather than acceptance proof. The notes do establish that a 3000 s run log includes time_s, controller_state, region, levels B3_level_m/B4_level_m/B5_level_m/B6_level_m/B7_level_m, compositions B3_w_NaCl and B5_w_NaCl, temperatures B5_temp_C/B6_temp_C/B7_temp_C, cooling-water flow FIS801_kg_s, commands P1_cmd/P2_cmd/B5_heater_cmd/B6_cooler_cmd/B7_cooler_cmd, and open states for V1/V3/V5/V6/V8/V9/V11/V12/V15/V18/V20/V22/V23/V24/V25. 02_02_process_data_register_chunk03 and 05_04_control_sequence_design explicitly request reporting tank levels and valve commands for a 900-second experiment, while 02_02_process_data_register_chunk04 A11/A12 define a 3000 s acceptance test and trace logging. Because the provided Stage 1 notes do not supply a clean acceptance result dataset, no check is claimed to have passed. 

Acceptance behavior that is explicit in the notes and suitable for later checking includes: complete automatic batch cycle using effective setpoints and approved return routing; B3 water prefill reaches LIS-301 >= 0.13 m; B3 recipe reaches QI-302 >= 0.080 kg/kg; B3 empties below 0.01 m; B5 charge reaches LIS-501 >= 0.18 m; evaporation reaches QIS-502 >= 0.180 kg/kg; B6 cooling reaches TIS-602 <= 20 degC before P2 return; B7 cooling reaches TIS-702 <= 25 degC before P1 return; parallel join requires both branches complete; simulation continues beyond 2500 s, and 3000 s is the released acceptance horizon in BAT-09. 

Legacy and conflict handling preserved from notes: 08_15_lab_notebook says pump transitions cause WaterNaCl to become unstable and a Q_up fix prevents B5 boil/no-boil switching; these are observations, not accepted design requirements. 02_02_process_data_register_chunk04 notes that acceptance procedures are verification sources, not design authority, and that legacy models/documents contain conflicting cooling setpoints and routing. Therefore approved corrections CR-017 and released BAT-09/Thermal Sizing Memo are used to resolve B7 temperature and benchmark cooling duties where directly stated, while unresolved topology/control details remain open questions.

tables.reason: Stage 1 notes indicate these chunks are a logged 3000 s run trace containing states, levels, temperatures, compositions, and actuator commands, but the extracted values are incomplete/inconsistent in the notes and are not treated as validated acceptance input.

assumptions: B5 in most notes corresponds to evaporator vessel D8 in 02_02_process_data_register_chunk01 because both carry LIS-501, QIS-502, and TI-503 and serve the evaporator role.
K1 in most notes corresponds to condenser B9 in 02_02_process_data_register_chunk01 because both are the condenser receiving B5 vapor/process side and using cooling water.
B6 and B7 in most notes correspond to cooling tanks B10 and B11 in 02_02_process_data_register_chunk01 by matching roles and instrument pairs LIS-601/TIS-602 and LIS-701/TIS-702.

For simulation metadata, stop_time is taken as 3000 s because BAT-09 released a 3000 s acceptance test and the run-log chunks are labeled as a 3000 s batch run; the separate 900 s report requirement is preserved as a distinct reporting context rather than the master simulation stop time.
Checks are recorded as threshold values from acceptance requirements; because the notes usually specify inequalities and not exact event times, at_time is left unspecified rather than invented.

clarifications.question: Which return destination and pump-to-branch assignment is current for B6 and B7, given conflicting notes?
clarifications.reasoning: 01_01_process_requirement_specification says P1 returns to B1 and P2 returns to B1, while 02_02_process_data_register_chunk00 contains contradictory repetitions placing B6/B7 returns to both B1/B2. 09_05_process_controls_email_thread explicitly states B6 condensate returns to B1 and B7 concentrate returns to B2, with P1 branch from B7 through V18/V23/V22 + V1/V3 to B1 and P2 branch from B6 through V20/V24/V25 + V5/V6 to B2, which conflicts internally. 02_02_process_data_register_chunk04 records approved CR-017 correcting return-stream destinations and B7 cooling target. The notes preserve a conflict between destination statements and branch-valve-group statements.
clarifications.suggested_value: Use approved return destinations B6 condensate -> B1 and B7 concentrate -> B2, while leaving exact pump/valve-group mapping as unresolved where notes conflict.

B6 returns to B1 and B7 returns to B2, with B7/P1 -> B1 via V18/V23/V22 + V1/V3 and B6/P2 -> B2 via V20/V24/V25 + V5/V6.
B6 returns to B2 and B7 returns to B1 as suggested by some repeated legacy/register lines.
